why: New theme #42 Darkroom (darkroom) shipped without a picker card or hero (owner rule 9: art is never rendered by code; the picker shows its CSS swatch until this lands).
instructions: Any image AI: follow the Drive doc 'ART_START_HERE (any AI: images + video)'. Claim it with {request id}.CLAIMED-{model}.txt first. takes 2 = make 2 versions named _take1/_take2 before the extension. One image at a time; stop at the first failure or credit warning and say how far you got. Save to 'Titan Reliquary/art-incoming (AI images + video)/artreq_20261022-0100_theme-cards-darkroom/' with the exact file names, then write artreq_20261022-0100_theme-cards-darkroom.DONE.txt next to this request (one line per file: ok or skipped: reason; your model name and date).

deliverable_spec.card: 16:10, at least 1280x800, PNG; the subject must read at 220x138 px (the picker card size on a phone)
deliverable_spec.safe_area: keep the top-left third of heroes calm and darker (or plain paper on light themes): UI text sits there

global_style: Real photography, not a render: shot like a high-end editorial or luxury-watch campaign on a full-frame camera, shallow depth of field, true reflections, physically accurate materials (toned silver with micro-scratches, gold, brass, marble, walnut, velvet, glass), soft volumetric light, rich natural grading, fine film grain. Real-looking coins or bullion in a place that fits the mood. Calm, expensive, cinematic. Exception: an image whose `medium` names an illustration, pixel art, clay or poster style is made in that medium, at the same premium standard (clean, crafted, never cheap clip-art).
negative: no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no faces, no hands, no 3D-render plastic look in the photo images, no oversaturation, no HDR halos, no warped or melting coins, no invented legible inscriptions
coin_rule: Coins look like real circulated or uncirculated world coins (a generic portrait, eagle or crest is fine); never invent a legible inscription.

images.prompt: Photograph inside a black-and-white darkroom lit only by a red safelight: looking down into a developing tray where a fibre print of a single real silver coin on black velvet is coming up out of the white paper, the developer rippling with soft caustics, the red safelight reflected in the liquid. Bamboo print tongs resting on the tray rim, a second tray at the edge of the frame, a mechanical darkroom timer with faint green luminous marks. Deep blacks, only red light, film grain, shallow depth of field. No text, no logos, no numerals.

The same darkroom, wider: three trays in a row (developer, stop, fixer) on a wet black counter, a print of a coin developing in the first, more coin prints hanging on a line above drying, the red safelight glowing in the corner, an enlarger in silhouette. Keep the top-left third calm and dark (UI text sits there). Only red light, deep blacks, film grain. No text, no logos, no numerals.
